Last time, you found a glowing door behind the gym. And another player.
His name is Kai. Orange hoodie. Red hearts. Not even surprised.
Rule one, he says. Lose all your hearts, and you respawn. Back in bed, next morning.
Rule two. The door only opens when you finish the quest.

text: Rule three. Every time you respawn... the game deletes something.

I had a bike, Kai says. Respawn number twelve. Gone. Like it never existed.
You run to the window and look down your street.
The neighbour is still watering his flower. But next to him...

text: Kai goes quiet. So... you've respawned before too?
